preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE system_id = 'admin'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM provider p JOIN users u ON u.person_id = p.person_id WHERE u.system_id = 'admin' AND p.retired = 0

changeSet.comment: Give the built-in admin user a provider, so admin can save forms in O3
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO provider (person_id, identifier, creator, date_created, retired, uuid) SELECT person_id, 'admin', user_id, NOW(), 0, 'ba1e27d3-2c89-49fc-9851-3b509abcce93' FROM users WHERE system_id = 'admin'

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scheduler_task_config WHERE name = 'Auto Close Visits Task'

changeSet.comment: Start core's Auto Close Visits Task at boot, so it stops the open visits of visits.autoCloseVisitType at its daily time, 23:59:59 server time
changeSet.sql: UPDATE scheduler_task_config SET start_on_startup = 1 WHERE name = 'Auto Close Visits Task'
